features: 550 TVL horizontal resolution, analog CVBS output (1.0 Vp-p, 75 Ohm)
Day/night with removable IR-cut filter; SensUp slow shutter up to 1 s
Wide Dynamic Range 92 dB (50 dB with WDR off)
Image stabilization; Sodium Vapor White Balance mode
Pan 360 deg continuous; preset speed pan 360 deg/s, tilt 100 deg/s; variable 0.1-120 deg/s
99 pre-positions, preset tour and two recorded tours
Bilinx over coax/UTP, Biphase, Pelco P/D, RS-232/RS-485 control
7 alarm inputs (2 EOLR supervised), 1 relay + 3 open-collector outputs
Outdoor pendant housing with sunshield, clear acrylic bubble (NEMA 4X except impact test with acrylic bubble)
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AutoDome_600_Data_sheet_enUS_18014400986189579.pdf, V18 2018), 28x Day/Night column and Outdoor Pendant column. VG5-613-ECS = PAL, VG5-623-ECS = NTSC (same 28x outdoor pendant camera, clear acrylic bubble). Sensitivity: min_lux_color = day mode 30 IRE SensUp off (0.33 lux), min_lux = night mode 30 IRE SensUp off (0.066 lux); with SensUp on 0.02 / 0.0026 lux. Power 51 W / 55 VA typical includes heater. Analog camera: no IP streaming.
